page: Amazon Web Services r7gd.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by an 8-core AWS Graviton Neoverse-V1 ARM64 processor running at 2.6 GHz. It features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and includes 474 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance allocates dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading, backed by 32 MB of L3 cache and 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark data shows strong memory subsystem performance, with the PassMark memory score reaching the top-tier category. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate read speeds of 774.56 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 181.03 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Computational benchmarks, including Geekbench and stress-ng, place the instance in the average tier for both single-core and multi-core operations, though PassMark CPU encryption and overall CPU scores register in the weak category.

The combination of high memory density, local NVMe storage, and average database operation performance makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads, caching layers, and database deployments. It achieves 12.13 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. The ARM64 architecture offers resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for workloads optimized for the Graviton instruction set, though it lacks specialized hardware accelerators like GPUs.
